---
title: "China Semiconductor Tracker: Facilities"
subtitle: "Tracking semiconductor manufacturing across mainland China"
date: last-modified
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/helpers.R")
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

facilities <- load_facilities("data/facilities.yml")
```

## The Story So Far

China's semiconductor industry is racing to indigenize under an expanding regime of US-led export controls. State financing through the National Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund (国家集成电路产业投资基金, "Big Fund") has backed fabs, memory makers, and equipment firms since 2014, while companies like SMIC have pushed mature-node lithography to produce chips at nodes once thought to require tools China cannot buy.

As of `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y")`, this tracker covers **`r nrow(facilities)` facilities** across **`r length(unique(facilities$province))`** provinces/municipalities. Disclosed investment stands at **¥`r format(sum(facilities$investment_rmb100m, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")`亿** in RMB-denominated figures and **$`r format(sum(facilities$investment_usd_m, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")`M** in USD-denominated figures — the two are shown separately rather than converted, since combining them would require an exchange-rate assumption (see [About](about.qmd)).

---

## Facility Map

Facilities are coloured by type, same as the [India Semiconductor Tracker](https://fabs.pranaykotas.com).

```{r map, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
colors <- unname(sapply(facilities$type, type_color))
popups <- vapply(1:nrow(facilities), function(i) make_popup(facilities[i, ]), character(1))
labels <- lapply(1:nrow(facilities), function(i) htmltools::HTML(make_label(facilities[i, ])))

# China's boundary CLIPPED of India's officially claimed territory, plus
# India's own official boundary — see load_boundaries() in R/helpers.R for
# why the raw ne_countries() China polygon is never drawn directly. No
# on-page disclaimer here by request; the clipping itself still applies.
boundaries <- load_boundaries()

leaflet(facilities, options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 10)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) %>%
  fitBounds(lng1 = 73, lat1 = 18, lng2 = 135, lat2 = 53) %>%
  add_boundary_layers(boundaries) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
    radius = 10,
    color = colors,
    fillColor = colors,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1.5,
    popup = popups,
    popupOptions = popupOptions(maxWidth = 320, minWidth = 220, autoPan = TRUE, keepInView = TRUE, autoPanPadding = c(20, 20)),
    label = labels,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-size" = "12px", "padding" = "6px 10px"),
      direction = "auto"
    ),
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(
      maxClusterRadius = 30,
      spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE,
      showCoverageOnHover = FALSE,
      zoomToBoundsOnClick = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = c("#620d3c", "#2f6b6b", "#1565C0", "#6A1B9A", "#455A64"),
    labels = c("Fab", "Assembly & Packaging (OSAT)", "Memory", "Compound Semiconductor", "Research Fab"),
    title = "Facility Type"
  )
```

## All Facilities

```{r table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
table_data <- facilities %>%
  mutate(
    Name = paste0('<a href="facilities/', id, '.html">', name_en, '</a>'),
    Category = sapply(category, category_badge_html),
    Status = mapply(status_badge_html, status, status_detail),
    Complexity = sapply(complexity_score, complexity_bar_html),
    Investment = mapply(format_investment, investment_rmb100m, investment_usd_m, MoreArgs = list(short = TRUE)),
    Location = paste0(city, ", ", province)
  ) %>%
  select(Name, Type = type, Category, Investment, Status, Complexity, Location)

datatable(
  table_data,
  escape = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "ftip", scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "display compact"
)
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Understanding the Metrics
- **Technical Complexity:** weighted score, 55% Technology Difficulty + 45% Capital Intensity, benchmarked against a 3nm fab (5/5). See [About](about.qmd).
- **Investment:** shown in ¥ (RMB) 亿 (100 million yuan); a dollar figure is shown alongside when a firm's investment is only disclosed in USD.
:::
